title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Venha fazer parte da Lindt Brasil!


Estamos com uma excelente oportunidade em nossa equipe


O que buscamos!


Nosso Executivo de vendas (Belo Horizonte - MG) tem como principal missão gerar crescimento sustentável de receita, garantindo presença, giro e rentabilidade dos produtos no mercado. Trabalho focando em campo e execução, 100% do tempo acompanhando e suportando as equipes da segunda força de vendas e top 20 clientes de cada uma das 4 operações de distribuição no estado de MG. Viagem é uma necessidade semanal.


Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão de contas e clientes : relacionamento com distribuidores e grandes varejistas, negociação de contratos, volumes, preços e condições comerciais.
  • Execução da estratégia comercial : implementação do plano de vendas, campanhas promocionais, lançamentos e ações de positivação nos pontos de venda.
  • Análise de mercado e resultados : acompanhamento de indicadores (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, mix, margem, rupturas, scanntech, mtrix), análise de dados e identificação de oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Planejamento e previsão de vendas : elaboração de JBPs com parceiros, definição de metas e alinhamento com áreas como marketing, logística e supply chain.
  • Gestão de equipes e parceiros (Distribuidores) : direcionamento, acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de representantes, vendedores e promotores de venda. 90% do tempo em rota.
  • Execução no ponto de venda : garantia de visibilidade, exposição adequada, cumprimento de planogramas e ações de trade marketing.
  • Negociação e tomada de decisão : condução de negociações estratégicas com foco em rentabilidade e construção de parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Gestão de recursos financeiros : gestão e controle de contratos, ações de rebaixa/visibilidade, orçamento e conta corrente.
  • Viagem é uma necessidade semanal.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • CNH ativa;
  • Perfil Analítico e Hands on;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


O que oferecemos!


Em nossa empresa, valorizamos cada colaborador como um pilar essencial do nosso sucesso. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios únicos que cuidam de você e de sua família!


  • Oferecemos benefícios de alimentação que valorizam sua autonomia. Com nosso VR e VA, você decide como e onde se alimentar, com qualidade e liberdade.
  • Convênio Médico: Nosso plano de saúde e odontológico garante o cuidado que você e sua família merecem.
  • Convênio com Academias: Bem-estar que faz parte do seu dia a dia! Temos parceria com academias para que você possa manter a energia e a saúde em alta. (Total Pass)
  • Seguro de Vida: Porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Nosso seguro de vida garante proteção e segurança em qualquer momento da jornada.
  • Desconto nos Produtos Lindt: Desfrute dos nossos chocolates inigualáveis com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.
  • Disponível automóvel alugado;
  • Vale Combustível.


Junte-se à Lindt


Inscreva-se e faça parte do legado!

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of high-impact features, mentor junior engineers, and drive best practices that ensure our sales analytics products scale with the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and optimize complex React applications and reusable component libraries
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish frontend coding standards across the team
  • Collaborate with product, UX, and backend engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, accessibility issues, and cross-browser inconsistencies
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions
  • Own release planning, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies to maintain >90 % test coverage


Need to Haves

  • 5+ years of production experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance frontend solutions
  • Strong English skills – comfortable presenting technical decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving technical excellence and mentoring teams


Nice to Haves

  • Deep domain expertise in sales or revenue analytics (CRM integrations, forecasting dashboards)
  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade design systems or HEX component libraries
  • Proficiency with Next.js, GraphQL, and cloud-native deployment (AWS Amplify, Vercel, or similar)

title: Analista de Microbiologia
description:
Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

A posição de Analista de Microbiologia é um componente importante de nosso time de Autógenas localizado em Guarulhos - SP.


Detalhes de posição

Dirigir, coordenar, organizar e priorizar as atividades da microbiologia (bacteriologia, virologia, biologia molecular e produção das sementes bacterianas e virais. Desenvolver protocolos e procedimentos referentes as demandas da rotina e de pesquisa de novos microorganismos , quando aplicavel. Ter conhecimento das técnicas de isolamento e identificação bacteriana e viral, avaliação de morfologia bacteriana, titulação viral, avaliação de efeito citopático, provas bioquímicas, produção de meios de cultura, conhecimento das principais patologias animais. Realizar os testes isolamento viral e bacteriano, bem como testes ligados a caracterização final dos microorganismos, visando a adequada seleção das sementes bacterianas e virais a serem utilizadas na produção de vacinas autógenas.


Responsabilidades chave


  • Realizar e acompanhar via supervisão direta as atividades do laboratório de microbiologia, desde o recebimento das amostras , sejam para diagnóstico , identificação ou seleção de sementes para produção de vacinas ,
  • Manter controle do estoque mínimo de insumos para realização das atividades.
  • Realizar os controles internos e externos de qualidade.
  • Auxiliar na análise dos resultados dos programas internos e externos de Controle da Qualidade.
  • Garantir que os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com os protocolos aprovados no laboratório.
  • Garantir que os registros de todas as etapas de diagnóstico sejam mantidos.
  • Liberar resultados pertinentes ao setor nos prazos acordados.
  • Acompanhar desvios de produção (problemas com amostras, resultados inconclusivos, resultados fora do prazo, resultados inconsistentes).
  • Elaborar, revisar e suportar a implementação de procedimentos, manuais da qualidade, e métodos analíticos necessários ao laboratório.
  • Manter comunicação clara e regular com o setor de diagnóstico, afim de cumprir as exigências e prazos na entrega dos resultados.
  • Promover reuniões regulares , para alinhamento de processos e treinamento de colaboradores.
  • Propor melhorias nos processos produtivos, implantação de novas tecnologias.
  • Acompanhar as demandas do laboratório de diagnostico, originadas dos problemas de campo a fim de auxiliar na identificação dos patógenos e sua caracterização.
  • Acompanhar os processos de validação de métodos analíticos, qualificação de equipamentos e calibração dos instrumentos do laboratório, referentes ao seu setor.
  • Garantir que os colaboradores do setor executem as operações de acordo com as normas de biossegurança vigentes.
  • Garantir a qualidade das sementes selecionadas para produção das vacinas bacterianas e virais.
  • Propor e executar planos de ação preventiva e corretiva decorrentes de investigações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhar auditorias dos órgãos governamentais e fiscalizadores e outras no setor, quando aplicável.
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua referentes a seu setor.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

In this role,  you’ll serve as a trusted partner to our clients—managing relationships, driving consultative sales, resolving issues, and supporting questions throughout the customer lifecycle. We value professionals who are agile, proactive, and passionate about delivering exceptional solutions.

  • Actively  identify  and engage potential customers to build a strong pipeline.  
  • Lead regular meetings with suppliers and clients to introduce  new solutions  and strengthen relationships.  
  • Conduct  timely  and  accurate  follow‑ups based on sales funnel stages.
  • Prepare, present, and deliver high‑quality commercial proposals.  
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to successfully close opportunities.  
  • Maintain an organized schedule and ensure all lead/client information is accurately updated in the CRM.  
  • Lead retention discussions and negotiate solutions with suppliers at risk of  churn .  
  • Participate in onsite client visits as needed.  
  • Represent  Syndigo  at trade shows, fairs, and other industry events.  
  • Identify  opportunities to improve internal processes, product offerings, or customer experience.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • 4+ years of relevant experience  
  • Bachelor’s degree  
  • Advanced English and Brazilian Portuguese  proficiency  
  • Proven experience in commercial sales roles  
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
  • Strong technical  proficiency   (Microsoft 365)  
  • Effective problem-solving, planning, and  organization  abilities
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Secretária
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados — e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor — e possível — continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gerenciar agendas múltiplas de executivos, com foco em compromissos institucionais, reuniões internas e externas.
  • Organizar e controlar a logística de viagens nacionais e internacionais (voos, hospedagem, traslados e agendas).
  • Apoiar a organização de eventos, reuniões estratégicas, visitas de consultores e stakeholders externos.
  • Apoiar processos administrativos como solicitações de compras, acompanhamento de contratos, controle de documentos, aprovações e trâmites internos.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento de demandas institucionais e administrativas vinculadas à presidência, diretoria e áreas correlatas.
  • Garantir organização, confidencialidade e priorização adequada das demandas executivas.
  • Antecipar necessidades, propor melhorias de fluxo e atuar de forma proativa no suporte à liderança.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa.
  • Experiência prévia como Secretária Executiva, Assistente Executiva ou função administrativa equivalente.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com rotinas administrativas e institucionais.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de escritório (Pacote Office e/ou Google Workspace).
  • Organização, discrição, autonomia e boa comunicação.
  • Perfil proativo e facilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Inglês (nível avançado para comunicação, organização de agendas e interações).


Informações adicionais:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

description:

Responsável pelo planejamento e implementação de projetos de automação, incluindo definição de atividades, recursos e entregas. É o principal ponto técnico de contato com o cliente, garantindo comunicação eficaz e alinhamento de expectativas.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Planejamento de Implementação (atividades, recursos, entregas);
  • Implantar ações para maximizar a margem do projeto (reduzir custos);
  • Definir um Pacote de Trabalho ou Escopo claro para equipes locais e externas;
  • Definir a solução técnica (HW, SW, Buyout) de acordo com as especificações do cliente, possuir a definição da lista técnica;
  • Identificação de Riscos;
  • Controle de desempenho (qualidade funcional, cronograma, orçamento de horas);
  • Ser o principal ponto técnico de contato com o cliente, garantir que a comunicação e as expectativas sejam claras;
  • Configuração de Sistemas de Análise de Vibração;
  • Análise de Documentação técnica;
  • Comissionamento de Sistemas de Análise de Vibração;
  • Configuração de Banco de Dados baseado no equipamento alvo da implantação;
  • Parametrização de sensores baseados em Setups.


Quem você é:

Você observa o ambiente em busca de novas habilidades técnicas, conhecimentos ou capacidades que possam beneficiar o desempenho profissional ou pessoal. Você investiga as causas raiz de um problema e busca padrões. Você define objetivos alinhados aos objetivos mais amplos da organização. Você desenvolve e entrega soluções que atendem às expectativas dos clientes. Você ouve os outros com atenção.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Computação, Mecânica ou Automação;
  • Experiência na área de automação industrial;
  • No mínimo 3 anos de experiência na área de engenharia;
  • Conhecimento em programação de Softwares e Sistemas de Análise de Vibração (desejável AMS Machinery Manager e AMS Machine Works);
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Local de Trabalho: Sorocaba - com alta disponibilidade para viagens.


Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
As the Senior Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk

management at Keeta.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios
  • Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider/driver/courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction
  • Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility/delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs).
  • Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution
  • Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics.
  • Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems
  • Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics.
  • Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design
  • Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization.
  • Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.


Technical Skills


  • Proficient in SQL and Python/R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement)
  • Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Familiar with risk assessment lifecycle: identification → quantification → monitoring → mitigation.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability
  • Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier/driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking
  • Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver/courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety/quality frameworks.
  • Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary)
  • Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

title: Gerente de engenharia de software
description:
Título do Cargo: Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA (AI Problem-Solving Architect)


Buscamos uma Liderança Disruptiva e altamente técnica para atuar como Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA. Este profissional será o principal resolvedor de problemas técnicos de alto nível, responsável por conceber, projetar e liderar a implementação de arquiteturas de Inteligência Artificial de última geração, com foco em sistemas de multiagentes. O papel exige profundos conhecimentos em LLMs, RAG, Deep Learning e experiência prática com orquestração de agentes (ex: CrewAI, LangChain), visando a criação de soluções mais eficazes, determinísticas e com alucinação minimizada. O líder será responsável por guiar e desenvolver uma equipe de 8 profissionais de alto desempenho, garantindo a transformação e modernização contínua dos nossos sistemas e processos.


1. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas (Liderança Disruptiva):

  • Liderar, inspirar e gerenciar uma equipe multidisciplinar de 8 profissionais (Cientistas de Dados, Engenheiros de IA/ML, etc.), promovendo uma cultura de experimentação, alta performance, agilidade e disrupção.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas, acompanhar o progresso dos projetos e garantir a entrega de soluções de IA que geram valor de negócio mensurável.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico, estimulando o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe nas mais recentes tecnologias de IA, Orquestração e LLMs.


2. Arquitetura e Engenharia de Soluções de IA:

  • Ser o "Arquiteto de Soluções de Problemas em AI", traduzindo desafios complexos de negócio em projetos de arquitetura de IA escaláveis, robustos e inovadores.
  • Projetar e otimizar sistemas de orquestração de Multiagentes , definindo fluxos de trabalho, comunicação (A2A - Agent-to-Agent) e protocolos de interação.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) e sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .
  • Garantir a integração e modernização das soluções de IA com os sistemas legados e plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).


3. Governança e Otimização de Agentes:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias e técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering e Context Engineering para controlar e guiar o comportamento dos agentes.
  • Implementar mecanismos de "guardrails" e estratégias de validação para diminuir a alucinação dos agentes , aumentando a eficácia, a precisão e o comportamento determinístico das soluções de IA.
  • Definir padrões de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), governança e monitoramento para garantir a estabilidade, segurança e conformidade das soluções em produção.


4. Estratégia e Inovação em Modernização:

  • Identificar e propor oportunidades de modernização tecnológica e disrupção em processos-chave da organização através do uso estratégico da IA.
  • Conduzir a avaliação e a adoção de novas ferramentas e frameworks de IA (como CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen, etc.) para acelerar a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos.


Experiência Técnica (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada no papel de Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Sistemas Sênior e função de liderança técnica equivalente, com foco em IA/ML.
  • Conhecimento Profundo (Hands-on) em:
  • LLMs (Large Language Models) e suas arquiteturas (Transformer, etc.).
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e otimização de bases de conhecimento para LLMs.
  • Orquestração de Multiagentes: Experiência prática com frameworks como CrewAI, LangChain ou ferramentas similares.
  • Deep Learning e frameworks como PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
  • Arquitetura de dados para IA (Vector Databases, Feature Stores, Data Pipelines).
  • MLOps e CI/CD para modelos e sistemas de IA.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de mitigação de bias e alucinação em LLMs, visando a deterministicidade.

Liderança e Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Liderança Disruptiva: Capacidade de desafiar o status quo , promover a mudança, tomar decisões ousadas e construir uma visão tecnológica ambiciosa.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para interagir com a equipe, stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Visão Estratégica e Habilidade de Solução de Problemas (AI Problem-Solving Architect).


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia em modernização de sistemas legados utilizando IA.
  • Publicações, contribuições ou participação ativa em comunidades de IA Generativa e Sistemas Multiagentes.
  • Certificações em Arquitetura de Nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) focadas em IA/ML.

title: Consultor de Vendas Pleno - Off Trade São Paulo
description:

title: Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.


Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.


Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função


  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.

title: Controller Financeiro
description:
A posição de Controller Financeiro será responsável por liderar o planejamento, controle e análise financeira da empresa, garantindo governança, eficiência operacional e suporte estratégico às decisões de negócio. O profissional atuará diretamente no segmento de construção civil e incorporação, com foco em empreendimentos MCMV, exigindo forte conhecimento das regras do programa, modelos de financiamento e particularidades do fluxo de caixa do setor.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o planejamento financeiro, incluindo orçamento anual (budget), forecast e análises de variação.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar fluxos de caixa operacionais e de obras, garantindo aderência aos cronogramas físico-financeiros.
  • Gerenciar indicadores financeiros e operacionais (margem, VGV, TIR, payback, custo por m², curva ABC, etc.).
  • Controlar e revisar orçamentos de obras, custos diretos e indiretos, medições e desvios.
  • Implementar e aprimorar controles internos, políticas e procedimentos financeiros.
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade econômica de novos empreendimentos, com foco em MCMV.
  • Acompanhar contratos de financiamento, repasses, medições e relacionamento com agentes financeiros (Caixa, bancos privados).
  • Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis, fiscais e regulatórias aplicáveis ao setor.
  • Liderar processos de fechamento contábil e gerencial, assegurando acuracidade das informações.
  • Apoiar a diretoria na tomada de decisão por meio de relatórios, dashboards e análises estratégicas.
  • Supervisionar equipes de controladoria, contabilidade, custos e financeiro (quando aplicável).

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada em controladoria no setor de construção civil/incorporação.
  • Conhecimento profundo do programa MCMV, suas faixas, regras de financiamento e repasse.
  • Domínio de orçamento de obras, curva S, composição de custos e sistemas de gestão (Sienge).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e domínio de Excel/Power BI.
  • Conhecimento de normas contábeis e fiscais aplicáveis ao setor imobiliário.
  • Vivência com análise de viabilidade econômica e modelagem financeira.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Capacidade de liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Organização, disciplina e atenção a detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de influenciar decisões.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de estruturar processos.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com incorporação vertical.
  • Vivência em empresas com múltiplos empreendimentos simultâneos.
  • Experiência com implantação de sistemas ERP no setor.

title: Senior BI Consultant
description:

  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

Modelo de atuação híbrido: três vezes por semana (segunda, terça e quinta-feira)


Objetivo da vaga:

Atuar como Product Owner responsável pela condução, priorização e evolução das iniciativas de modelagem de risco de crédito, garantindo que as necessidades de negócio sejam corretamente traduzidas em backlog e entregas técnicas, considerando dois pilares estruturantes do modelo:


1 - Pilar Crédito – variáveis, premissas, regras e lógica do modelo de risco de crédito;

2 - Pilar Agro – variáveis do agronegócio que influenciam diretamente o risco de crédito e precisam ser incorporadas ao modelo.


O profissional será responsável por garantir continuidade, qualidade e governança do conhecimento, evitando perda de contexto ao final de projetos e assegurando evolução contínua do modelo.


Escopo técnico da atuação


Pilar 1 – Modelagem e variáveis de crédito

Entendimento profundo da lógica de modelos de risco de crédito (inputs, premissas, critérios de decisão, indicadores e outputs);

Atuação próxima às áreas de risco e dados para definição, priorização e evolução das variáveis do modelo;

Tradução de necessidades regulatórias, de negócio e operacionais em requisitos claros para times técnicos;

Garantia de rastreabilidade entre necessidade de negócio → backlog → entrega técnica → resultado.


Pilar 2 – Variáveis do agro aplicadas ao risco de crédito

Compreensão das variáveis do agronegócio que impactam o risco de crédito (ex.: sazonalidade, produtividade, clima, ciclos agrícolas, indicadores setoriais);

Capacidade de estruturar essas variáveis como hipóteses, requisitos e critérios de priorização dentro do modelo;

Interface com áreas de domínio (quando necessário) para garantir correta interpretação e aplicação das variáveis no contexto de crédito.


Responsabilidades

Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog das iniciativas de modelagem de risco de crédito;

Conduzir refinamentos e planejamentos com foco técnico e objetivo, garantindo clareza para os times de dados/modelagem;

Escrever user stories, critérios de aceite e dependências com nível de detalhamento adequado para execução técnica;

Garantir alinhamento contínuo entre negócio, risco, dados e tecnologia;

Atuar como ponto central de governança do tema, preservando conhecimento e histórico das decisões do modelo;

Acompanhar entregas, validações e indicadores de qualidade do modelo;

Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas à evolução do risco de crédito.


Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Product Owner (ou papel equivalente) em contextos analíticos, dados ou modelagem;

Vivência prática com modelagem de risco de crédito (variáveis, lógica de decisão, indicadores);

Capacidade comprovada de atuar entre negócio e times técnicos (data science/modelagem/engenharia de dados);

Experiência com metodologias ágeis e gestão de backlog em ambientes complexos;

Autonomia, organização e clareza na comunicação técnica.


Diferenciais relevantes

Experiência com agronegócio aplicado a crédito;

Vivência em ambientes regulados e com forte exigência de governança;

Histórico de atuação garantindo continuidade de conhecimento entre projetos.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Teltonika IoT Solutions Brazil is a representative branch of Teltonika IoT Group, which has been creating and manufacturing Internet of Things (IoT) for over 20 years. From connected vehicles to networking, we seek our solutions to be used globally and become an indispensable part of any business. By setting new trends, we inspire our partners to change the world and use the most advanced technologies in the market.


We are constantly growing and looking for an organized IoT Solutions Engineering Specialist to join our team in São Paulo, SP .



In this role, you will:

  • Work with various Teltonika Telematics-manufactured GNSS tracking devices that embed technologies such as Bluetooth, CANbus, RS232/RS485, and 1-Wire
  • Propose different ways on how to incorporate our devices for various use cases
  • Be responsible for arranging technical tasks for custom development projects and coordinating solution release to clients
  • Troubleshoot, provide assistance, and consult clients via a dedicated ticketing system or online meetings/chats if they are needed
  • Communicate with global international corporations that provide car sharing, rental, fleet management solutions and various other companies from different vehicle telematics fields
  • Cooperate with R&D, quality assurance and project management teams to ensure the maintenance of the projects and that solutions reach the clients on time
  • Have an opportunity to go on business trips to visit clients and help them directly implement Teltonika devices into their business use cases.
  • Guide colleagues and customers by preparing wiki documentation or training

What we expect of you:

  • Great communication skills, are capable of fluently speaking and writing in English (proficiency in other languages will be considered as an advantage)
  • Telecommunications, electronics, informatics, engineering education or previous work experience in technical or engineering fields
  • Passion for providing help to others, caring, willing to grow and enrich your technological know-how
  • Analytical and creative thinking and mindset for problem-solving and troubleshooting
  • Understanding or basic knowledge of telecommunication technologies (2G, GPRS, 3G, 4G), CANbus, BLE
  • Knowledge or work experience working with ticketing-based platforms (Jira, GitLab, OpenProject, ServiceDesk) (this will be considered as an advantage)
  • Experience in customer service (this will be considered as an advantage)

What we offer:

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller

Location: Barra da Tijuca


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.


Key Responsibilities

Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;

Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;

Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;

Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;

Support month-end and year-end closing activities;

Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;

Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);

Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;

Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;

Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;

Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;

Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.


Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

Fluent English;

Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;

Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Bl.

title: Senior Developer Support
description:
ADP Brazil Labs is hiring a Senior Developer Support - Lyric


  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?


In this role, you will work within a scrum team to bring the designs and ideas to life for new or improved web applications. This work will support a mix of internal and external clients. You will work with clients, product managers, architects, software engineers, and more to plan, design, develop, test, and implement impactful solutions that support companies with one to millions of employees.



Hybrid work model, office located in Porto Alegre/RS.



To thrive in this development career, you'll need to be an expert in:


  • Advanced English;
  • Knowledge in SQL, Splunk, Oracle DB, Dynatrace, Troubleshooting;
  • Experience researching and evaluating possible root causes of issues;
  • Experience developing workarounds and redirect the problems to a final solution;
  • Software development experience in a product-based company involving in complete SDLC of the product development particularly using Agile SCRUM methodology;
  • Understanding of RESTful and microservices development;
  • Analytical mind;
  • Knowledge of Automation and Continuous Integration Tools;


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You'll start each day with a scrum, working in a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities while choosing user stories to complete. You will also participate in other agile ceremonies, including scheduled sprint demos, where you will present your work to up to 90 stakeholders.


  • Build teams that thrive . As an experienced leader, you want everyone to shine. You'll start each day by checking in with your engineering team to identify priorities and challenges. You'll find a way to make the team's day go smoother. You are constantly looking for ways to share your knowledge, motivate others and keep everyone engaged and productive.
  • Build Products. You will use your technical expertise to review your team's work and help your people excel in an Agile environment. You're proactive and hands-on. When you see a potential issue, you never leave things hanging and unfinished. When you and your team deliver a finished product, it's as polished as you could make it.
  • Variety of work. There is no typical day. You could be checking in with a team in India one minute, meeting with leadership to review initiatives for the coming quarter later and tomorrow handling a few ad hoc requests from your peers in other departments.


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale.We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

"Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador"

title: Salesforce Analyst
description:
Job Title : RevOps Analyst

Location : Hybrid (Heber City, 3 days in-office – 2 days remote)

Employment Type : Full-Time


Mission: Why we exist, What we do and Why we need you


RevBlack exists to revolutionize revenue operations, turning CRM systems into engines of growth and efficiency. We specialize in optimizing Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and RevOps using tools like HubSpot and Salesforce to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions for our clients.


RevBlack is not for everyone. It’s for the curious, fast learners who take ownership and thrive on high standards. We work hard, move fast, and deliver work that makes a difference. If you’re seeking an easy job, this isn’t it. But if you’re ready to push your limits and grow, we want you.


We need a RevOps Analyst to drive client success by implementing CRM solutions, optimizing processes, and providing insights that fuel revenue growth. You will apply your technical and analytical skills in the fast-paced world of SaaS and B2B operations. You'll become specialists in Salesforce and HubSpot to streamline workflows, support data-driven decisions, and drive both operational efficiency and client success.


What you’ll own

  • Drive Client Revenue Growth: Implement and manage CRM solutions that lead to measurable revenue increases.
  • Optimize Operational Processes: Streamline revenue operations to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Maintain Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy for informed decision-making.
  • Provide Strategic Recommendations: Analyze data to offer insights that boost client success.


What we’re looking for.

  • CRM Experience: Experience or strong interest in RevOps, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, CRM Administration, or a related professional services delivery role.
  • Operational Expertise : Deep knowledge of sales, marketing, and customer success operations.
  • Analytical Prowess: Strong skills in data analysis and process optimization.
  • Business Knowledge: Strong business acumen with an understanding of the SaaS business model and B2B environments.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and a willingness to deepen technical knowledge.


Why Join RevBlack?

  • Be part of a dynamic and innovative team that delivers high-quality, impactful work tailored to our clients' needs.
  • Enjoy a flexible work environment with a hybrid modality, competitive salary, and benefits like unlimited PTO.
  • Take advantage of significant opportunities for career growth, with a strong focus on continuous learning and skill development.
  • Work in a transparent and communicative culture where clarity and collaboration are key to success.


If you’re ready to make a difference in the RevOps world, apply now to join RevBlack.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil


about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

Requirements

Please share your resume in English .

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account’s objectives and the client’s initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.


This position will require a live SQL Assessment.
